title: RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 - Kuldra Is EASY! Raid Boss Guide
author: Kodeations
description:
Struggling with Kuldra? This RuneScape Dragonwilds guide breaks down all 4 phases of the Kuldra raid boss fight, including Anima pylons, orbs, the resonator cannon, safe spots, and the final Heart phase.

Whether you're going for your first clear or farming Kuldra for Dragon gear, this should make the fight MUCH easier.

⚔️ Let me know what drop you got from Kuldra!
